response.original_title: Edward Albee's Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf?
response.overview: In the early hours of the morning on the campus of an American college, Martha, much to her husband George's displeasure, has invited the new professor Nick and his wife Honey to their home for some after-party drinks. As the alcohol flows and dawn approaches, the young couple are drawn into George and Martha's toxic games until the evening reaches its climax in a moment of devastating truth-telling. Produced by Sonia Friedman Productions, this stage play production of Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf? ran @Sohoplace in London from September 21 until December 19, 2026.
